findings.finding: Choices use only saved private server bindings with exact session ID/version/pending step/rule and binding hash. Client interface consumes only choice key and expected version, not fact payload.

Only exact reviewed EXP003 BOOLEAN EQ true proposition receives observation choices. Centred binds confirmed boolean true; not centred false; unsure has no fact. Unrelated question receives no generic yes/no controls.

ACTION_COMPLETED_UNRESOLVED retains no observed fact; trusted terminal controller refers to OEM support and does not repeat. Corrections display the actual active proposition and suppress superseded observation labels despite legacy enum preservation.

Canonical gate reason alone formerly allowed forged technical text. Final adapter also requires exact approved wording, complete claim-to-evidence mappings, source readiness, reviewed step and exact evidence/page closure.

Safety wording formerly allowed wrong citation pages/checksum. Final common technical check requires immutable manual/index identity, original page provenance and zero-based index correspondence; scoped verified_safety_claims remains required.
Public citations retain only evidence/page/manual/index metadata. Source text, crops, bounding boxes and evidence delivery URIs are excluded; stopped/error paths issue no action choices.

Initial acceptance tool uses reviewed GEN007 from initial30 catalogue, exact authorized Cloud Run HTTPS origin and rejects redirects for authenticated Cloud Run/Firestore reads. Receipt stores hashes/routes/timings without credentials or technical text.

limitations: Adapter is not an eligibility or authentication authority. It must receive trusted controller/composer output after real retrieval and exact runtime/source gates.
No installed rider HTTP endpoints, session ownership/capability enforcement, Firestore CAS integration, operation reservation or durable choice storage reviewed or approved here.
Choice hash is a binding check, not a secret capability or proof of ownership; saved private map must remain server-controlled.
No full adaptive scope, successor edges, repeat authority, photo handling, public PDF/excerpts/images or deployment approval granted.

Acceptance script was not executed live. It observes committed Firestore records after receiving SSE; commit-before-first-output ordering additionally requires exact server-code review and correlated evidence.
Acceptance tool SSE iteration is suitable for bounded trusted smoke output but is not the public client implementation or comprehensive stream-size/disconnect/failure validation.
Warm/cold classification, p95, second-principal ownership, physical TTL deletion and fresh-browser rider API acceptance remain unmeasured.
Generic versions TTL remains unapproved. Dedicated arm_a_session_versions retention change requires exact new runtime and cloud configuration review.
Runtime/source hashes are exact-version bound; changed bytes require new review. Historical prior runtime review cannot substitute for installed endpoint review.
